Ledger/Voucher में Interest Rate, Style (365 दिन)

📌 ज़रूरी नोट

📘 Practice Problems

हर Problem में करना है: Enable Interest Calculation on the Party Ledger with the given Rate/Basis/Credit Period, pass the Purchase and Payment Vouchers, and verify the Interest Calculation report.
guide:
Interest Calculation

हर Problem: क्या करना है → Steps → Entry Table → ✅ Check (उत्तर-कुंजी से मिलान)।

सबसे पहले — Interest की तैयारी

  • F11 (Features) → Activate Interest Calculation = Yes, Use Advanced Parameters = Yes।
  • Party Ledger खोलें → Activate Interest Calculation = Yes → Set/Alter Interest Parameters।
  • भरें: Calculate From (Past Due Date), Rate %, Per (Year / Month), Style (30-Day Month / 365-Day Year / Calendar Month), Applicable on (Debit/Credit Balance)।
  • Credit Period Party Ledger या Voucher के Bill-wise Details (Due on) में भरें।
  • Interest निकालें: Gateway → Display More Reports → Statements of Accounts → Interest Calculations।
  • Interest को Books में लाएँ: Journal (F7)। Debtor पर: Party Dr / Interest Received Cr। Creditor को देना हो: Interest Paid Dr / Party Cr।
याद रखें

Simple Interest = P × R × दिन ÷ (365 × 100)।

Interest Credit Period के बाद से शुरू होता है (Due Date से)।

Days गिनते समय Start और End दोनों तारीख़ मत गिनें।

Interest Income (Debtor से) = Indirect Income; Interest Paid = Indirect Expense।

problems.title: Simple Interest Warm-up
problems.q:
🟢 Basic

  • 1st April — Sold goods on credit to Mr. Rajan for ₹ 50,000, with 12% p.a. Simple Interest chargeable if unpaid after 30 days (30-Day Month basis)
  • 31st May — Mr. Rajan has still not paid; calculate the interest due for the overdue period (1st May to 31st May, 30 days, since the bill became overdue after 30th April)
problems.hint:
• 1 Apr: Sales Mr. Rajan ₹50,000 (Credit Period 30 दिन, Due 30 Apr)।
  • Rajan Ledger: Interest Rate 12% p.a., Style = 30-Day Month, Calculate From Due Date।
  • 31 May तक देय Overdue अवधि = 30 दिन (1 May से 31 May)।
problems.full:
मदहिसाब
Principal₹50,000
Rate12% वार्षिक = 1% प्रति माह (30-Day Month)
Overdue30 दिन = 1 माह
Interest50,000 × 1% = ₹500
✅ Check

Interest for 30 overdue days @ 12% p.a. = ₹500 ✔

problems.title: XYZ Firm — Partial Payment, Credit Period, 30-Day Month
problems.q:
🟡 Intermediate

  • 2nd August — XYZ Firm purchased 35 Pcs HCL (I3) Laptop from Digital Computer @ ₹31,200/Pcs, on credit
  • 2nd August — Paid for 30 Pcs by cheque the same day; remaining 5 Pcs' amount stays due
  • Digital Computer charges Interest @ 1.5% per month (30-Day Month basis); Credit Period = 10 days from the date of purchase
  • 31st October — Calculate the total Interest chargeable on the outstanding amount
problems.hint:
• 2 Aug: Purchase Digital Computer से 35 Pcs HCL (I3) @ 31,200 = ₹10,92,000 (उधार)।
  • उसी दिन 30 Pcs की रकम Cheque से चुकाएँ (Payment, Agst Ref): 30 × 31,200 = ₹9,36,000।
  • Digital Computer Ledger: Rate = 1.5% per month, Style = 30-Day Month, Credit Period = 10 दिन।
  • बाकी 5 Pcs = ₹1,56,000 पर Interest।
problems.full:
मदहिसाब
Total Purchase35 × 31,200 = ₹10,92,000
Paid (30 Pcs)₹9,36,000
Outstanding (5 Pcs)₹1,56,000
Due Date2 Aug + 10 दिन = 12 Aug
Overdue दिन12 Aug से 31 Oct = 80 दिन
Interest1,56,000 × 1.5% × 80 ÷ 30 = ₹6,240
✅ Check

Outstanding Principal (5 Pcs) = ₹1,56,000 ✔

Interest Due Date = 12 August ✔

Interest for 80 days @ 1.5%/month = ₹6,240 ✔

problems.title: ABC Pvt Ltd — Changing Interest Rate, Calendar Month Basis
problems.q:
🟠 Advanced

  • 2nd June — ABC Pvt Ltd purchased 1 Pcs Bajaj Microwave Oven from Mehta Electronics @ ₹12,000, on credit
  • Interest Rate: 1.5% per Calendar Month up to 31st July; 2% per Calendar Month for August
  • 31st August — Calculate the total interest chargeable (use 'Apply Date Specified during Entry' for the changed rate)
problems.hint:
• 2 Jun: Purchase Mehta Electronics से Bajaj Microwave Oven ₹12,000 (उधार)।
  • Mehta Ledger: Style = Calendar Month, Rate = 1.5% per month।
  • Rate बदलना है: Interest Parameters में दूसरी Line जोड़ें — "Applicable From 1 Aug", Rate = 2%। Setting में "Apply Date Specified during Entry" चुनें।
  • 31 Aug तक Interest Calculation Report देखें।
problems.full:
माहहिसाबInterest (₹)
June (28/30)12,000 × 1.5% × 28 ÷ 30168
July (पूरा माह)12,000 × 1.5%180
August (पूरा माह, 2%)12,000 × 2%240
कुल Interest588
✅ Check

June = ₹168 • July = ₹180 • August (2%) = ₹240 ✔

Total Interest = ₹588 ✔

problems.title: PQR Pvt Ltd — Credit Period + Calendar Month, 4-Month Span
problems.q:
🔴 Expert

  • 1st September — PQR Pvt Ltd purchased 1 Pcs Sony LED W32672E from Gargi Electronics @ ₹25,000, on credit
  • Credit Period = 3 days from date of purchase; Interest Rate = 3% per Calendar Month, calculated from the due date
  • 31st December — Calculate the total interest chargeable for the full period (September to December)
problems.hint:
• 1 Sep: Purchase Gargi Electronics से Sony LED W32672E ₹25,000 (उधार)।
  • Ledger: Credit Period = 3 दिन; Rate = 3% per Calendar Month; गणना Due Date से (Due = 4 Sep)।
  • 31 Dec तक Interest Calculation Report देखें।

माहहिसाबInterest (₹)
September (26/30)25,000 × 3% × 26 ÷ 30650
October (पूरा)25,000 × 3%750
November (पूरा)25,000 × 3%750
December (पूरा)25,000 × 3%750
कुल Interest2,900
✅ Check

Interest Due Date = 4 September ✔

Sep (26/30) ₹650 + Oct ₹750 + Nov ₹750 + Dec ₹750 = ₹2,900 ✔

problems.title: Debtor पर Interest — Overdue Bill
problems.q:
🟢 Basic

  • 1st April — Mr. Verma को ₹ 50,000 का Maal उधार बेचा (Credit Period 15 दिन)
  • 30th May — Verma ने पूरा ₹ 50,000 चुकाया। Overdue Interest 12% वार्षिक (Simple, 365 दिन की गणना) लगाइए।
problems.hint:
• 1 Apr: Sales Mr. Verma को ₹50,000 (उधार, Credit Period 15 दिन)।
  • Due Date = 1 Apr + 15 = 16 Apr। Ledger: 12% p.a., Style = 365-Day Year।
  • 30 May: Verma ने पूरा ₹50,000 चुकाया (Receipt, Agst Ref)।
  • Interest निकालें और Journal से Verma Dr / Interest Received Cr करें।
problems.full:
मदहिसाब
Due Date16 April
Overdue Days (16 Apr से 30 May)14 + 30 = 44
Interest50,000 × 12% × 44 ÷ 365 = ₹723.29
✅ Check

Due Date = 16 April; Overdue Days = 44 ✔

Interest = ₹723.29 ✔
